cues.text: Junpei lays Chidori down on the paving and bows over her. Junpei gets to his feet and turns toward Takaya. Chidori lies still on the ground behind him.
Junpei puts his Evoker to his head and fires.

Junpei's Persona hovers face to face with Chidori's Persona, Medea, a pale figure with blade-like wings, and the two draw together. In a burst of light they become one new Persona: a slender masked figure with great jagged wings spread wide.
The Persona hurls a blast of fire up the steps. Jin runs in front of Takaya and takes it.
Jin drops to one knee. Junpei sinks to his hands and knees beside Chidori.
Jin pulls the pin from a grenade and throws it. Thick smoke rolls over the steps and everyone below them.
Yukari runs to Junpei, kneels and holds him back as the rest of you gather around.
Junpei pushes himself up and stands with his head bowed, then turns to Chidori. He kneels beside her.
